integrations.title: Calendar & channel sync
integrations.subtitle: Subscribe other platforms to this calendar, import external blocks, and pull existing Zodomus reservations.
integrations.howItWorksLead: Sync is asymmetric: Booking/Airbnb reservations arrive fully into the RentAI calendar, while CRM only pushes date occupancy to the channel — it does not create a guest reservation on the OTA.
integrations.howItWorksInbound: OTA → Zodomus → RentAI: new, modified, and cancelled bookings arrive via webhook, queue sync, or import of future reservations (guest, dates, price, status).
integrations.howItWorksOutbound: A direct CRM booking closes nights on the channel: RentAI pushes occupancy (availability 0) to Zodomus so the OTA cannot sell those dates.
integrations.howItWorksDirectCancel: Cancelling a direct (local) booking reopens those dates on the channel (availability 1).
integrations.howItWorksOtaCancel: You cannot cancel an OTA booking from CRM — cancel on the platform; RentAI then receives the status. A cancel attempt returns OTA_CANCEL_VIA_CHANNEL.
integrations.howItWorksImportVsQueue: “Import future reservations” is a one-time summary pull; “Sync OTA queue” processes new/changed channel-manager events. They are different actions.
integrations.exportHint: Paste this URL in the other platform as “import calendar” or sync URL. It lists confirmed bookings from RentAI (guest names are hidden).
